dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Awesome. So you're the money person. Got it.

dialogues.speaker: Liloa
dialogues.text: Well, someone's got to do the work! And we need money if we want to tackle more important issues.

dialogues.speaker: Liloa
dialogues.text: I'm not a natural fighter, but I have a knack when it comes to making money. Seems like everyone has their place in life, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Liloa
dialogues.text: Manua's got a lot of experience, but he cuts Miss Amina a bit too much slack sometimes.

dialogues.speaker: Liloa
dialogues.text: Plus, if you ask me, I think his biggest wish is for Miss Amina to grow up as soon as possible, so he can also retire and spend the rest of his days in the hot springs.

dialogues.speaker: Liloa
dialogues.text: They're lucky that I'm very patient, and can help them slowly turn all of those outlandish ideas into reality.
